turns.prompt: which kvm switch holds 4k 144 hz between a macbook pro and a gaming pc on one monitor
queries: site:tesmart.com 4k 144hz HDMI 2.1 KVM 2 computers 1 monitor Mac
turns.answer:
For a MacBook Pro + gaming PC sharing one 4K 144Hz monitor, I'd recommend a DisplayPort 1.4 KVM with DSC or an HDMI 2.1 KVM supporting 48Gbps.

The key is maintaining 4K 144Hz on your gaming PC while switching to your MacBook Pro without unplugging cables.

Be careful: many KVM switches advertised as "8K" or "4K 144Hz" don't actually support that refresh rate with every connection configuration.
